name: GE Vernova
summary: SmartSignal combines operating measurements in multivariate diagnostic models; it does more than display separate sensor readings. APM Health is a related but distinct condition-monitoring path. Exact model internals and site-specific integration remain outside the reviewed evidence.

flows.name: SmartSignal predictive analytics

steps.label: Machine sensor data
steps.detail: Operating measurements such as load, temperature, pressure and vibration feed asset-specific models; the vendor does not prescribe a single sensor brand.

steps.label: SmartSignal: combined sensor evidence
steps.detail: Multivariate AI/ML models estimate expected readings across operating conditions; related sensor deviations and expert-defined failure modes support diagnosis.

steps.label: SmartSignal / APM view
steps.detail: Users review alerts in SmartSignal; when integrated with APM, outputs contribute to health dashboards and reliability activities.

flows.caveat: SmartSignal is offered independently or as an APM pillar. Proficy Historian, Mark VIe and a cloud provider are not required stages in every deployment.

evidence_fusion.assessment: At the analytics layer, multivariate models relate sensor readings to operating conditions. GE demonstrates pressure and temperature deviations together narrowing a diagnostic advisory.
evidence_fusion.limits: Vendor documentation establishes combined analysis, not independent accuracy. Exact input selection and handling of missing or conflicting signals require deployment-specific evidence.

flows.name: APM Health condition monitoring

steps.label: Field and route evidence
steps.detail: APM Health can combine sensors, OT/IT systems, historians and operator rounds.

steps.label: Health indicators
steps.detail: Defined performance rules create descriptive alerts; this path does not require SmartSignal model inference.

steps.label: Rounds and work planning
steps.detail: Health Manager, Rounds Pro, eLogs and recommendations to EAM systems support operator and maintenance decisions.

flows.caveat: APM Health and SmartSignal can complement each other, but the cited pages do not make every feature a default installation.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §6 and vendor-landscape-eight-majors.md §2: SmartSignal is specifically MSET plus empirical nonlinear regression and 'rather than deep neural networks'
findings.assessment: Current GE Vernova material supports similarity-based modeling, healthy-history empirical models and residual analysis. It does not substantiate MSET as the specific current algorithm or rule out neural methods throughout the product.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-landscape-eight-majors.md §2: 'Not one of these is machine learning'
findings.assessment: GE Vernova explicitly calls SmartSignal's digital twin blueprints AI/ML-driven and describes trained machine learning analytics. The categorical claim is false for SmartSignal.

The current product page says precursor signatures draw on data from over 19,500 assets. It separately describes analytic blueprints for equipment classes; the 19,500 count should not be relabeled as failure-mode blueprints.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §6: SmartSignal covers 350+ equipment types and time-to-action analysis
findings.assessment: The current product page states analytics for 350+ equipment types and describes time-to-action forecasting.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §6: Proficy Historian is the on-prem store for air-gapped SmartSignal sites
findings.assessment: GE Vernova sells Proficy Historian for cloud or on-prem use, but the cited product pages do not establish it as SmartSignal's required or exclusive store.

unknowns: The current public pages do not disclose SmartSignal model internals enough to identify a single precise algorithm such as MSET.
Site-specific ingestion connectors, persistence, hosting and alert validation procedures require deployment documentation.
